notes:
Account background:
- Ridgewell Opsware: mid-market SaaS (product analytics + in-app assistant), 320 employees, US HQ. CTO: Javier Morales. Primary buyer: Head of Product (Emily Park). AE: Maya Chen. SE: Jordan Patel.

Hosted API trial summary (Feb 01 - Mar 01):

- Purpose: fast experiment with in-app assistant + contextual search. Evaluate latency, cost, and model quality before committing to Dedicated.
- Test traffic: synthetic + staged beta (1.2k beta users, 15% of prod).
- Measured metrics (trial): average QPS: 12 (baseline), typical burst peak: 65 QPS (short bursts at 30s windows), sustained peak observed during end-of-day reports: 92 QPS for ~3 minutes.
- Token mix during trial: chat generation ~68% of requests, embeddings (document indexing) ~27%, reranking ~5%. Average tokens per chat request: 420 tokens (prompt ~140, completion ~280). Embedding batch size avg: 6 docs/request, avg tokens/document ~650.
- Latency: p50 ~320ms, p95 ~1.25s on Hosted API (multi-region us-east fallback), timeouts observed when bursts >70 QPS (client-level 10s).
- Cost note: trial spend $9.6k/month (hosted). Engineering flagged unpredictability in p95 during bursts as primary reason to explore Dedicated.

POC ask / Dedicated sizing notes:

- Goal: predictable tail latency (p95 < 450ms for chat at production peak) and lower unit cost for steady-state traffic. CTO requested p95 < 250ms for interactive flows; product team okay with p95 < 450ms for background tasks.
- Forecasted growth for next 12 months: active accounts ramp from 200 -> 1,600, monthly DAU from 8k -> 50k. Expected request mix scales similarly; projected average QPS (month 6): 48 QPS; projected peak QPS (sustained 5m): 180 QPS; short burst peaks: 320 QPS for up to 30s.
- Concurrency planning: expected concurrent generation streams at peak ~42 (streams that hold KV cache), ephemeral concurrency for batching ~120.
- Token throughput target: steady-state ~90k tokens/sec across fleet at month 6; peak token/sec target ~450k tokens/sec during promotional events.
- Desired Dedicated config: multi-GPU pool supporting autoscaling + burst capacity; preference for colocated us-east-1 for data residency. VPC-only control plane, KMS-managed keys.
- SE request: workshop to map QPS -> GPU count with typical token mix (chat/embeddings/rerank). Need model family recommendations (quantized variants) to be cost-effective.

Security / procurement steps:

- Completed: SOC2 questionnaire, basic SSO/SAML integration demo.
- In flight: DPA review with legal (expected 3 weeks), KMS integration proof-of-concept (security team).
- Compliance ask: log retention 1 year for audit events, ability to export audit logs to their SIEM.

Open action items:
